Title: EVT-OP-015: Other processes with a mesoscopic phase transition
Labels: open-problem, area:dependence, type:research, difficulty:medium, status:research

**Status in the survey:** OPEN-EXPLICIT; partly answered by the two echo processes, which have different transitions from Bai–Kulik–Wang's linear interpolation.

## Source and quote
Bai, Kulik and Wang, arXiv:2409.17966v2, §1.4:

> It would be very interesting to know whether such a phase transition exists for any other regularly varying stochastic processes.

The same paper, introduction:

> It is left to further research that whether other models with weak extremal dependence but violating the anticlustering condition may exhibit a similar phase transition at mesoscopic level as revealed here.

The quote was extracted from the source text, with symbols flattened; check it against the published version before citing.

## Why it matters
It shows how block length interacts with clustering, and feeds EVT-OP-001. The survey rates the practical relevance as modest.

## What the library already has
`logEchoProcess_phase_transition` (a continuous transition with a kink) and `powEchoProcess_polyBlocks` (a step transition).

## What is missing
A process with the same linear interpolation as Bai–Kulik–Wang's.

## Pointers
`docs/PRACTICAL_OPEN_PROBLEMS.md`, §0, questions 1 and 3. Survey feasibility estimates are unchecked plans, not results.
